documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Dated July 21, 2026
Intimation Pursuant To Regulation 36(1)(B) Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Dispatch Of Letter With Web-Link Of Annual Report For Financial Year 2025-26

analysis.summary: Nanta Tech Limited reported its H2 and FY26 financial results, posting revenue from operations of INR70.1 crores and crossing INR70 crores for the full year. Managing Director Mayank Jani highlighted strategic expansions including the formation of a UAE subsidiary and a robotics R&D platform, TRN. Management noted strong demand in the robotics and AI segments, which command higher EBITDA margins compared to audio-visual solutions. For FY27, the company guided for approximately 50% revenue growth and an increase in EBITDA margins. Nanta Tech Limited released its investor presentation for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting strong operational and financial performance with a revenue growth of 37% to 7,010 lakh and a 74% increase in net profit to 817 lakh.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve around 50% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, that's because of that business that we are seeing. We are looking forward to that at the same time. EBITDA percentage also, we are seeing that it's going to crease, because of our product business mixture of Robotics and AI is going to get more business.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to increase by 2% to 3% in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The global service robotics market is projected to exceed $107 billion by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: The global service robotics market is expected to exceed $107 billion by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: India's AV hardware market is anticipated to grow at a CAGR of roughly 9.8% through 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s AV hardware market is expected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 9.8% through 2030, while the digital signage market is projected to grow at around 10% CAGR and the video conferencing market at approximately 11% CAGR over the same period.

demand_outlook.claim: The UAE subsidiary targets approximately USD2 million, or around INR30 crores, in business for FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: UAE subsidiary, we are expecting right now to get a business near by USD2 million. Which is in INR, we are expecting to get around INR30 crores of business that is from a UAE subsidiary..

capex_expansion.claim: Nanta Technologies FZ LLC was incorporated as a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates.
capex_expansion.quote: One of the most recent significant developments has been the incorporation of Nanta Technologies FZ LLC, our wholly-owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates.

capex_expansion.claim: The setup cost for the UAE subsidiary is approximately INR20 to INR25 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: And structure cost is around INR20 to INR25 lakh rupees in INR, including all the costs to start up a business over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established TRN, The Robotics Nexus, as a dedicated R&D platform for robotics, AI, and automation.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our vision of becoming a technology-led innovation company, we have established TRN, The Robotics Nexus recently, a dedicated platform focused on research and development in robotics, artificial intelligence, and automation technologies.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition cost of RSVP Infotech was approximately INR98 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: The acquisition cost we already declared was around INR98 lakh.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated TRN India Private Limited on April 24, 2026, to strengthen R&D in robotics and automation.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for H2 FY26 reached INR8.4 crores with an EBITDA margin of 17.3%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR84 crores, registering a robust growth of 122.3% over the corresponding period last year. Consequently, the EBITDA margin improved by 580 basis points to 17.3% compared to 11.5% in H2 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, EBITDA was INR11.5 crores, yielding an EBITDA margin of 16.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for FY26 stood at INRI11.5 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 78.8% year-on-year, while the EBITDA margin improved by 390 basis points to 16.4% from 12.5% in FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Robotics hardware margins typically range between 20% and 25%.
margins_costs.quote: Our margin in robotics hardware is typically anywhere from 20% to 25%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Profit Margin improved to 48.6% from 21.6% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: Over the past year, we continued to strategically rebalance our portfolio towards Robotics & Artificial Intelligence solutions. This shift is clearly reflected in our profitability, with Gross Profit Margin improving to 48.6% from 21.6% in FY25 and EBITDA Margin expanding to 16.4% from 12.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company deployed and sold over 400 robots across various industries during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, we also achieved a significant operational milestone by successfully deploying and selling over 400 robots across various industries, further strengthening the market presence of our Albotix robotics platform and validating the growing acceptance of automation solutions among enterprise customers.

orders_capacity.claim: Nanta Tech secured an AI automation solution order worth INR6.6 crores from Pointer Insurance Broker Private Limited.
orders_capacity.quote: Further reinforcing our growing capability in enterprise AI solutions, we recently secured a significant AI automation solution order worth INR6.6 crores from Pointer Insurance Broker Private Limited.

capital_allocation.claim: Bank borrowings carry an interest rate of 9.50% and a tenure of 8 years.
capital_allocation.quote: The rate of interest was around 9.50% and the tenure was 8 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided not to recommend any dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to grow revenue by around 50% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are continuously to grow in FY27. We are expecting to grow around 50% in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The Experience Center is nearing completion, with approximately 95% of the work done.
management_commitments.quote: We have been working to get our Experience Center up and ready. Almost 95% of the work is already being done.

management_commitments.claim: RSVP Infotech's existing clients are expected to contribute INR15 crores to INR20 crores of business in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we are expecting at least INR15 crores to INR20 crores of business to come from RSVP’s existing clients that we are going to serve under Nanta Tech Limited this year.

management_commitments.claim: R&D spend in TRN is expected to be around INR2 crores to INR3 crores.
management_commitments.quote: So, as of now, we have not calculated the entire year, but yeah, 1t would be around INR2 to INR3 crores we are expecting. At least, that will do into TRN.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from the UAE subsidiary is expected to start coming in from Q2 of India.
management_commitments.quote: We are expecting from the next quarter onwards, we are expecting to start getting revenue from the UAE subsidiary that is from Q2 of India.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets signing at least 15 dealers and distributors across India and UAE by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Okay, so in FY27, we are targeting to get at least 15 dealer and distributor that is including UAE and across India also.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand across GCC markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Kuwait.
management_commitments.quote: Aims to expand across GCC markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait, focusing on urban infrastructure and industrial development opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to set up an in-house assembly unit for robotics and automation products.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to expand into smart buildings, industrial automation and logistics solutions, while setting up an in-house assembly unit for robotics and automation products.
